About

Hi, I'm Rishika.

I'm a B.Tech Electronics and Computer Science student, which means most of my week is spent thinking in circuits and code. Design is where the other half of my attention goes — building brand worlds, drawing characters, and putting together the small visual details that make something feel considered.

I work mainly in Canva and Ibis Paint, and I like projects with a strong point of view: a community that needs a tone of voice as much as a logo, a channel that needs thumbnails people recognize instantly, a sticker sheet that needs its own cast of characters.

Let's work together

Have a brand, a channel, or an idea that needs a visual world?

I take on brand identity, social content, thumbnail sets, and illustration work. Reach out through either handle below.
